```yaml
name: Update dependencies to fix security vulnerabilities

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 2 * * *' # run daily at 02:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: update-dependencies
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  update-dependencies:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Harden runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          allowed-endpoints: |
            api.github.com
            api.github.com:443
            registry.npmjs.org
            registry.npmjs.org:443
            proxy.golang.org
            proxy.golang.org:443
            github.com
            github.com:443
          egress-policy: block
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          disable-telemetry: true
          disable-sudo: true
          disable-file-monitoring: true
          policy: default

      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache-dependency-path: '**/go.sum'

      - name: Update Go dependencies
        run: |
          go get golang.org/x/crypto@v0.45.0
          go get golang.org/x/sys@v0.38.0
          go mod tidy

      - name: Set up Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: '**/package-lock.json'

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        uses: bahmutov/npm-install@v1
        with:
          working-directory: .
          useLockFile: true
          useRollingCache: true
          install-command: npm ci
          cache-key-prefix: npm

      - name: Audit and fix npm vulnerabilities
        run: |
          npm audit fix --force
          npm audit fix

      - name: Create pull request
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v5
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: 'chore: update dependencies to fix security vulnerabilities'
          branch: update-dependencies-${{ github.run_id }}
          title: 'chore: update dependencies to fix security vulnerabilities'
          body: |
            This PR updates Go and npm dependencies to address all open Dependabot security alerts.
            - Go: golang.org/x/crypto v0.45.0, golang.org/x/sys v0.38.0
            - npm: Updated packages and added overrides to resolve transitive vulnerabilities.
          labels: dependencies
          reviewers: ''
          assignees: ''
          draft: false
          delete-branch: true
```
